data_pipeline.ingestion: Real-time transaction stream ingested via Apache Kafka or AWS Kinesis.
data_pipeline.database_storage: Raw transactions stored in PostgreSQL; account/entity relationship graph stored in Amazon Neptune or Neo4j Graph Database.
data_pipeline.feature_store: Feast or Redis Cache to store precomputed node embeddings, account balances, and rolling network density metrics.

offline_batch_training.frequency: Daily / Weekly batch retraining to update Graph Attention parameters on newer nodes and relationships.
offline_batch_training.execution: Airflow DAG triggering a SageMaker PyTorch Training Job. Output weights saved to AWS S3.

real_time_scoring.engine: FastAPI microservice containerized with Docker, deployed on AWS ECS or EKS (Kubernetes) with auto-scaling.
real_time_scoring.embedding_lookup: Look up precomputed GNN node structural embeddings from Redis (latency < 2ms) rather than re-evaluating the full GNN over the entire graph for every transaction.
real_time_scoring.classification: MLP Edge Classifier combines source account embedding, target merchant embedding, and active transaction parameters (amount, distance) to score risk instantly.

explainability_engine.framework: Kernel SHAP running asynchronously via Celery Task Queue to prevent blocking the real-time scoring path. Explanations are cached in Redis and pushed to the fraud analyst dashboard.

alerting_dashboard.frontend: Streamlit Dashboard running in an ECS task or internal Kubernetes node, presenting visual analytics, topological maps, and explainability waterflows.
alerting_dashboard.action_trigger: High-risk predictions (Probability >= 0.8) trigger real-time PagerDuty alerts or customer transaction declines automatically via webhook.

scaling_limits.gpu_acceleration: NVIDIA T4 or G4dn instances for offline GNN training.
scaling_limits.concurrency: FastAPI + Uvicorn handles up to 5,000 requests/sec when structural GNN embeddings are served from memory/Redis.
